notes:
V3.3.0 — patent + moderator (closes V3.0.0.txt items 14 & 15).

🛡  COPYRIGHT / SIMILARITY CHECK
• Every publish runs a similarity pre-flight against the existing marketplace. Algorithm: Python tokenizer → normalise identifiers / strings / numbers → 5-gram set → Jaccard distance vs each existing bot.
• ≥85 % match: server returns 409 + the desktop shows a 'Cannot publish — too similar to X' dialog. Bot does NOT upload.
• ≥60 % match: desktop shows a soft warning; author can override.
• Standalone endpoint POST /bots/check-similarity if you want to query without committing.

⚖  MODERATION (admin-only)
• New MODERATION card in ADMIN tab: enter a slug + reason, then click 🚩 Flag (hide) · ✓ Unflag · ⚠ Remove + refund.
• FLAG: bot disappears from marketplace listings + search. Already-installed copies stay live. Other approved bots from the same publisher are unaffected.
• REMOVE: full takedown. Every buyer gets their credits refunded; every installed copy is revoked (deleted from their library on next launch via /bots/mine/revocations). Publisher fined 500 ◊ and publish-banned for 7 days. Their OTHER approved bots stay live (per your spec).
• Server-side: new public_bots.status column (active/flagged/removed), new bot_purchases table, new users.publish_ban_until column, new server/similarity.py + server/moderation.py modules.

🔄  REVOCATION SYNC (every user)
• Desktop polls GET /bots/mine/revocations on launch (4.5 s after open) → deletes any revoked bot from DATA_DIR/bots and from bot_registry. Shows a one-shot dialog listing what was removed.
• Free downloads now also create a purchase row (credits_paid = 0) so moderation can later track + revoke them too.
